text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.8c7a1e0425: Under the red sun, all hope was lost, and the age of witchcraft came to an end. A new god was born.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.4116386025: It tells you to take it to one of Lyior's statues
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.2f239b5cf8: Plagued with endless hunger he strove through the landscape, consuming everything in a mad attempt to satiate his appetite.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.a37e790807: Breaks the barrier on the 1st floor of the main hallowed tower
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.746f5ead5f: An invitation to the three Hallowed Towers
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.d1e0320c1f: The rusty steel cuts deep into your flesh. The blade is heavily damaged and the handle fell off a long time ago.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.82fcc3e1a7: Holding it rapidly fills up your rot bar
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.c32b92e7de: Passive Ability: Each time a target is hit, the grief bar slowly fills up. While you're cursed with grief, the Louring Claymore deals additional damage that ignores the target's armor
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.d35fd39a42: Having it near you fills you with an unbearable amount of joy.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.cf0f3be35e: "My duty is fulfilled. However, our story is far from over. May we meet again."
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.60b3737181: Sudden eruptions will rot the insides of your enemies
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.38c50f57de: Provides the caster with various positive effects
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.af57ee3fb5: Fires your stomach contents onto your enemies
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.38b6adf9df: Cleanses the caster of the following curses: Rot, Grief
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.97734655ff: Screams mixed with gagging will poison all enemies within range
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.6f0c2f2a01: Every living creature in a 64 block radius will be highlighted (this does not include other players)
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.2c25f11349: Godmother of every infant of Aenthir. One of the few witches that survived the day of the white flame.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.20f6aeda70: A strange symbol is burned into the paper. Looking at it gives you a weird feeling of melancholy.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.3c4b5f4c5f: can be exchanged for weapons by speaking to a Wandering Trader
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.2f73f6ca82: (A text is carved into the blade, it reads: "o kindred of mine, thy wings are wilted")
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.19fa7ee0e5: Deals 75% additional damage when it's raining and 150% additional damage during thunderstorms
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.9a687530f0: It's written in a language you don't understand
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.4e69b9f633: A relic from the age of magic. The spirit possessing it holds onto it tightly
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.efbaba6d2f: Ability: Bow down for an area attack that deals 20 damage points
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.2c1c80b68d: (The very first staff of the Ivory Devil)
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.7560f87a9c: Linara: I bid thee for forgiveness
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.9f35e05a8b: Linara: My goal was to find out how resistant thou art against the vile curse called manic
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.be31d199d4: Linara: And here thee standeth before me.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.acdb0c1cc4: Linara: I have to go now.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.54d45dc09b: Linara: My duty is needed elsewhere.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.25f0689d5d: Linara: I am Linara, one of the many scions of the children of aenthir
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.635cb3cf1c: Linara: Thou wert cast into this realm with a purpose.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.8b14dcb57f: Linara: We are both of like kind.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.825c7a88c6: Linara: Led by the grace of the white flame.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.98afb9d4a4: Linara: Alas, our encounter is blessed with fleeting attention.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.fe0e9d32df: Linara: Here, take this invitation and show it to my mistress.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.9814873faa: Linara: She awaits thy arrival in the main hallowed tower.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.827eba185d: Linara: I watched thou fight against the Nameless Gatekeeper
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.ad8c31059b: Linara: The wind whispers to me.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.b5b057cb74: Linara: His rotten mind still taints the canvas of our world
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.66de5b3bd5: Linara: could thee go back to the church of the oath pus for me?
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.70c61aa8a4: Linara: I bear the key to a treasure room
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.af3cf4a324: Linara: Thy payment shall be the rest of the treasure.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.87a93d650b: Linara: I shall wait here for thee to return
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.6c16af8781: Marlene: As promised, I shall convert the memory thou hast obtained.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.0dc694559f: Marlene: Did mother send thee forth?
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.38eeb66467: Marlene: I sense thou hast gotten hold of a memory?
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.d5e599b9e3: Marlene: but only if thou offer me thy help first.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.8fb04962ee: Marlene: I am a scholar of the written word, a seeker of forgotten lore
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.cbd3483b75: Marlene: Bring me a book, a tale I have not yet encountered.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.171f4fc46d: Marlene: When thou hast found it, return to me, and I shall grant thy wish.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.e023139505: Marlene: Thee should head to the observatory
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.a43a76d635: Marlene: Mother wishes to test thy strength in a duel.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.4ef9e8d4e6: Marlene: I wish thee good luck...
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.4c0454a3d5: Saphyra: At last, I have found one, enduring enough to confront the horrors that linger within this world
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.6552ce1771: Saphyra: Though I regret placing this burden upon thee, know that thou art the chosen one to end our suffering.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.6d83a0c9b7: Saphyra: Thou art in possession of his memory, I perceive.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.53725027b2: Saphyra: She is a student of mine,
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.5e76359dd9: Saphyra: And the only one able to convert his past.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.68f9887651: Saphyra: It will open the path to her room.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.3a9db853bb: Saphyra: She stands upon the second level.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.04421a79aa: Saphyra: Once it is done, return to me.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.e33cdf6a74: Saphyra: Welcome, to the very heart of our universe.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.02608f68c0: Saphyra: And the birthplace of Meryd and the white flame.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.f51f30739c: Saphyra: I urge thou not to hold back.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.f7c02d8778: Saphyra: Well then, let us begin.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.f3b88d7bf2: Saphyra: May the stars align and take on the form of our new member.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.5401200598: Saphyra: I sense great potential inside of thee.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.7028a76586: Saphyra: And a will to rival the shattered goddess
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.503d04e754: Saphyra: The path ahead is fraught with peril, but together, we shall overcome.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.8acbeff166: Saphyra: Head to the church of the oath pus and defeat the Nameless Gatekeeper
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.2c87d4eec6: Saphyra: I will wait here for thee to return.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.00cd489868: ???: Linara informed me of thy imminent arrival.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.8fc2aaa537: Saphyra: I am Saphyra, one of the few remaining witches that still draw breath in this world.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.e83a41005e: Saphyra: As the leader of the children of aenthir, I welcome thee into my guiding embrace.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.662d986245: Saphyra: Hand me the invitation Linara gave thee.
text.saphyra_reborn.hardcoded.89e39c5710: Saphyra: And I will gladly adopt thee into my loving care
text.saphyra_reborn.story.sigil3_hint: It pulls you towards the Fractured Clock Tower
text.saphyra_reborn.story.sigil3_wrong_p: The sigil stays silent. This is not the place.
text.saphyra_reborn.story.puppet_awakens: The red sun answers. Something stirs inside the tower...
text.saphyra_reborn.story.marlene_saphyr: Marlene: Mother's memory... It still burns with the red sun.
Marlene: The sigil has awakened once more.
Marlene: Take it back to the Fractured Clock Tower, where thy journey began.
text.saphyra_reborn.story.linara_ct_1: Linara: So the puppet has fallen at last.
text.saphyra_reborn.story.linara_ct_2: Linara: The Manic Eye thou brought me showed me where it hid.
text.saphyra_reborn.story.linara_ct_3: Linara: It was once a child of Aenthir, bound by Yiva's strings.
text.saphyra_reborn.story.linara_ct_4: Linara: Give me its memory, and I shall set its soul free.
text.saphyra_reborn.story.linara_ct_6: Linara: Take these. They belonged to it before the binding.
text.saphyra_reborn.story.linara_ct_7: Linara: Our paths shall cross again. Farewell.
text.saphyra_reborn.book.dondra_witches: As an act of Celebration, the Dondra captured every remaining witch that escaped the blazing inferno of the white flame. Tearing out their vocal cords before offering it to their new god.
text.saphyra_reborn.book.adira_godhood:
"Those who strive to become a god shall inflict pain upon this world."

I have seen it... The ascension to godhood.



It disgusts me.
text.saphyra_reborn.book.lyior_rose: And Lyior rose from the charred pile of dead bodies. The stench of burned flesh and scorched hair filled the air. Crying out into the sky, tainted by the very presence of the red sun.
text.saphyra_reborn.book.augurium_3.page:
Rules:

A special type of magic imprinted on a scroll. Commonly consisting of offensive spells.

A rule is often linked to a curse, making them indestructible against fire and other sorts of danger.

A rule arises from the experience a witch had before her death.

It is impossible to create a rule without the consequence of deviating from life.

A rule is a part of us
and a part of life.
A rule is a last farewell to the ones we love.
text.saphyra_reborn.book.augurium_5.page:
Curses:

A dangerous type of magic. Although not always deadly, it is a painful and traumatic process.
 
A curse can harm the physical or mental health of the affected person.

There are 7 types of curses.

Disgust: 
Causes vomiting until death by starvation.

Grief: 
Uncontrollable crying causes the affected to drown in tears. Can rarely lead to suicide.

Rot:
Microscopic fungal growth causes immense heat. Followed by small spore emissions.

Rooting:
Roots shoot out of the ground, holding the affected person in place.

Manic:
Intense positive thoughts flood the affected person, causing severe deformation, twitching and laughing.

Affection:
Forcing the affected person to show love. This very rarely results in death.
